secede.definition: v. withdraw from an organization or communion
secede.translation:
vi. 正式脱离(或退出), 分离
[法] 退出, 脱离

seceded.translation: v. 脱离, 退出( secede的过去式和过去分词 )

seceder.definition:
n. One who secedes.
n. One of a numerous body of Presbyterians in Scotland who
   seceded from the communion of the Established Church, about the year
   1733, and formed the Secession Church, so called.
seceder.translation: n. 脱离者, 分离者

seceders.definition:
plural of seceder
n. One who secedes.
n. One of a numerous body of Presbyterians in Scotland who
   seceded from the communion of the Established Church, about the year
   1733, and formed the Secession Church, so called.
seceders.translation: (seceder 的复数) n.脱离者, 分离者

secedes.definition: v withdraw from an organization or communion
secedes.translation: v. 脱离, 退出( secede的第三人称单数 )

seceding.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Secede
seceding.translation: v. 脱离, 退出( secede的现在分词 )

secern.translation: v. 区别, 分开, 分泌

secerned.translation:
vt. 区别；分泌
vi. 分开；分泌

secernent.definition:
a. Secreting; secretory.
n. That which promotes secretion.
n. A vessel in, or by means of, which the process of
   secretion takes place; a secreting vessel.
secernent.translation:
a. 分泌的
n. 分泌器官, 分泌促进剂

secerning.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Secern
secerning.translation:
vt. 区别；分泌
vi. 分开；分泌

secernment.definition: n. The act or process of secreting.

secerns.translation:
vt. 区别；分泌
vi. 分开；分泌

secesh.translation: abbr. secessionist 脱离论者，分离论者

secession.definition:
n. an Austrian school of art and architecture parallel to the French art nouveau in the 1890s
n. the withdrawal of eleven southern states from the Union in 1860 which precipitated the American Civil War
n. formal separation from an alliance or federation

secessionism.definition: n a doctrine that maintains the right of secession
secessionism.translation: n. 脱离论, 分离主义

secessionist.translation: n. 脱离论者, 分离论者

secessionists.translation: n. 脱离论者, 分离论者( secessionist的复数形式 )

secessions.definition:
plural of secession
n. an Austrian school of art and architecture parallel to the French art nouveau in the 1890s
n. the withdrawal of eleven southern states from the Union in 1860 which precipitated the American Civil War
n. formal separation from an alliance or federation
secessions.translation: (secession 的复数) n. 脱离, 分离
